PSX Tracker guide

Export and reconcile your PSX portfolio

A tracker earns trust only when it matches reality. Export on a schedule and reconcile after big imports, rights issues or messy OCR days. This article is a practical checklist.

Start freeAll guides
On this pageWhat to export and keepReconcile holdingsReconcile cash and incomeAfter you fix the book

What to export and keep

Use in-app export or Sheets-related flows when available so you have a dated copy outside the browser. Store it where you can find last month’s file.

Exports complement Drive sync; they are snapshots you can email to an advisor or diff locally.

Reconcile holdings

Compare quantity and average cost per ticker with the broker app. Investigate mismatches before the next sell so FIFO lots stay clean.

Common culprits: duplicate imports, wrong symbols, forgotten corporate actions, or trades entered in the wrong portfolio.

Reconcile cash and income

Check deposits, withdrawals and dividends against bank or broker cash reports for overlapping dates.

If withholding appears on dividends, ensure your ledger’s net and tax lines can explain the credit you saw.

After you fix the book

Correct trades, export again, and sync Drive so every device shares the cleaned state. Then place new trades.

Reconciliation is boring — and cheaper than rebuilding a year of lots in April.
